title: The Navier-Stokes $1,000,000 Problem: Why Turbulence Breaks Math
description: Millennium Prize #2: A cinematic 2:20 visual journey through the Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem — Kelvin-Helmholtz vortices, Reynolds transition, Biot-Savart advection, 3D vortex stretching, and Kolmogorov's turbulent cascade.
